rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Caster
rules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

rules.name: Caster Group
rules.description: This model counts as having Caster(1).

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Hive Bond
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Hive Bond, they always get +1 to Morale Test rolls from Hive Bond (instead of only when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Hive Bond Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Hive Bond. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Valiant
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Valiant, they always get +1 to Morale Test rolls from Valiant (instead of only when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Fragment
rules.description: When attacking units where most models have Defense 4+ to Defense 6+, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 4-6.

rules.name: Furious
rules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Furious Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Hit & Run Fighter
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after being in melee.

rules.name: Hive Bond
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

rules.name: Imprecise
rules.description: Gets -1 to hit when attacking.

rules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +6" range on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Infiltrate
rules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

rules.name: No Retreat
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

rules.name: Piercing Growth
rules.description: Place one token on this unit at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four tokens. For every two tokens, models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons.

rules.name: Piercing Target
rules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them.

rules.name: Precise
rules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

rules.name: Precision Debuff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Predator
rules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

rules.name: Predator Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Predator. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Rapid Charge Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game moves +4" when using Charge actions. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Self-Destruct
rules.description: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. If this model survives melee, after both sides have finished attacking, it is immediately killed, and the enemy unit takes X hits.

rules.name: Spell Conduit
rules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

rules.name: Spell Resistance
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Stealth Buff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets Stealth once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Unique Hero
rules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Unwieldy
rules.description: Strikes last when charging.

rules.name: Valiant
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

spells.name: Animate Spirit
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Enhanced Hive Bond once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Hive Shriek
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Infuse Bloodthirst
spells.effect: Pick up to three enemy units within 24" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Fighter against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Overwhelming Strike
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Fragment.

spells.name: Psychic Blast
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with AP(2).

spells.name: Terror Seeker
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Hit & Run Fighter once (next time the effect would apply).
